description: ITS Legacy Radio Propagation Data is provided by NTIA Institute for Telecommunication Sciences. The ITS landing page identifies legacy propagation measurements collected between 1944 and 1995. The collections include long-distance radio measurements, irregular-terrain tests, low-antenna-height measurements, atmospheric attenuation observations and mobile channel impulse responses. Experiments differ in frequency, geometry and date; this is a collection of campaigns, not a uniform monitoring network. Potential simulation use: Calibrate radio-path loss, attenuation and coverage models.
